name: Atra
desc:
Atra is a Khan NPC. She is a member of [The Hundred Legions](faction:the_hundred_legions) and currently belong to the 11th Scouting Legion. She stays with her group composed of [Caitus](entity:caitus), [Lars](entity:lars), [Gaius](entity:gaius) and [Amara](entity:amara).

She gives you the 'Legion Scout' quest, urging you to find Lars, another scout of the 11th Legion.
